lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The wind howls across the agrarian lowlands of Oakhaven. Golden wheat bends beneath dark gathering stormclouds.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Keep low. The Citadel walls are behind us, but the criers have already ridden ahead.

lines.speaker: Vargas (Spirit)
lines.text: ...Commander... I smell grease-torches and steel ahead. Voices in the granary...

lines.speaker: Angry Peasant
lines.text: There! The church bells were right! Look at the fiend's hands—corpse light! He's defiling the dead!

lines.speaker: Peasant Militia
lines.text: Stay back, monster! For King Alden! Protect the harvest! Slay the butcher!

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Wait! Listen to me! I am the one who felled the demon lord! We bled for you...!

lines.speaker: Peasant Militia
lines.text: Lies from a demon's mouth! Draw the scythes! Kill the witch before he takes our sons!

lines.speaker: Vargas (Spirit)
lines.text: ...Commander... their terror has made them deaf. Form the line. We must defend ourselves...

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Twilight settles cold over the wooden beams of Oakhaven Granary. Outside, the routed militia disperses into the mist.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: They fled without casualties. We held the line without becoming the butcher Alden claimed I am.

lines.speaker: Vargas (Spirit)
lines.text: ...Mercy is an expensive luxury for the dead, Commander. Every blow you pulled cost us essence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Hero reaches into an open grain sack, breaking a crust of fresh rye. He chews slowly, but tastes only chalk and cold iron. His fingertips radiate frost beneath the torches.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: ...The bread. It tastes of nothing. Just... ash.

lines.speaker: Vargas (Spirit)
lines.text: ...The pale flame claims what the living take for granted. And the Church inquisitors will not be as forgiving as terrified farmers.

lines.speaker: The Hero
lines.text: Then we do not linger. We march north into the Mourning Crags before dawn breaks.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He clutches the grimoire tight with deadened hands. The path ahead is steep and unforgiving, but the Vanguard marches onward.
